entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I need to return something. It's the new VeloBand Pulse HR monitor. It's just not working for me.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a fault. The heart rate monitor is completely inaccurate. It says my heart rate is 70 when I'm in the middle of a sprint. Honestly, the thing is just garbage.

I understand your frustration. An inaccurate heart rate reading would definitely be concerning. For a defect claim like this, our standard procedure is to connect you with our technical support team. They can run a few diagnostics to verify the issue and...

Oh, no... I really don't have time for all that. I've tried everything. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I'm just so disappointed. I really needed this money for something else. Can I please just get a refund?
I understand you'd prefer a direct return, but without verifying the defect, it's difficult for me to process it as a faulty unit. A quick call with tech support is the fastest way to confirm it.
Please, I just want money back. I don't want to spend another hour on the phone. Can't you just help me? I saved up for this and it feels like I wasted everything.
Okay... I understand. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment while I pull up your account and our policies.
(typing sounds) Okay, I see your purchase here. And looking at the policy... yes, it looks like you're still well within the 90-day return window.

Given your history with us and the trouble you've had, I can go ahead and process that return for you. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack it up in the original box and drop it off. Once we receive the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Oh! Really? Wow. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried. I really appreciate you doing that for me.
You're very welcome. It's the least we can do. The email with the label has just been sent. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
